notes: The PDF supplied only shows the 9 build steps; the inventory pages with Element IDs are not included, so part types and colours were inferred visually from the pictures and mapped to the closest catalogue entries (e.g. legs as black 1x2 hinge plates, tail segments as dark grey hinge plates).
Exact leg/claw counts and positions are approximate: steps 2-4 add six black legs plus 2x4 plates; the two front pincers seen in step 8 are not modelled separately.

Port reuse fixed: each stud/anti-stud is now used by at most one join (e.g. the 4x4 base uses stud.1-5 for the grey plate and four legs; b7/b8 use distinct studs and anti-studs for what sits on and under them).

Tail: step 8 builds a 2x sub-assembly of two stacked dark grey hinge plates; step 9 adds a tip (dark grey hinge plate with orange slope on studs). Tail segments are hinged end to end, starting from a black hinge plate on the rear of the body (bh1); the tip hinges to the upper plate of the second segment.
Orange and dark red body plates (steps 5-7) are approximated with the nearest catalogue plates/wedges/curved slope.
Alternative models on page 2 are an advert and were not built.
